form.label: Silent Sources
form.description: Currently monitored sources whose silence threshold has been exceeded.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_state | where effective_state="SILENT" | eval haystack=lower(index." ".host) | where ($silent_index|s$="*" OR index=$silent_index|s$) | where len(trim($silent_text|s$))=0 OR like(haystack,"%".lower(trim($silent_text|s$))."%")

div.p: Sources that have exceeded their configured silence threshold and require investigation.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_state | where effective_state="SILENT" | stats count BY index | sort 0 index
| stats max(age_seconds) AS age | eval value=case(isnull(age),"-",age<3600,round(age/60,1)." min",age<86400,round(age/3600,1)." h",true(),round(age/86400,1)." d") | fields value

| eval Threshold=round(threshold_seconds/60,0)." min", Silent_for=case(age_seconds<3600,round(age_seconds/60,1)." min",age_seconds<86400,round(age_seconds/3600,1)." h",true(),round(age_seconds/86400,1)." d"), Over_threshold=case((age_seconds-threshold_seconds)<3600,round((age_seconds-threshold_seconds)/60,1)." min",(age_seconds-threshold_seconds)<86400,round((age_seconds-threshold_seconds)/3600,1)." h",true(),round((age_seconds-threshold_seconds)/86400,1)." d"), Last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort 0 - age_seconds index host | rename index AS Index host AS Host | table Index Host Threshold Silent_for Over_threshold Last_seen
